how_to_apply: Visit the Bank's official website at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ and download the detailed advertisement to confirm eligibility.
Click "Apply Online" and register for the post of "Specialist Officer (I.T)" using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
On successful registration, note the Registration Number and Password sent to the registered mobile number, and click the activation link sent to the registered email ID.
Log in to the careers portal using the Application/Registration Number and password, and fill in all required details carefully across each page, clicking "Save/Continue."
Upload photograph (390 x 520 pixels, max 120 KB) and signature (240 x 240 pixels, max 60 KB, not in capital letters).
Upload the required enclosures - SSLC/Higher Secondary certificate, Degree certificate(s), Experience certificate(s), Relieving Letter, and Last Month Salary Slip - each under 250 KB.
Review all details, then click "Confirm/Submit" to complete registration; a "Registration is successful" message will be displayed.
A system-generated copy of the application will be sent to the registered email ID - take a printout for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must keep their personal email ID and contact number active until the recruitment process is complete. The name of the candidate and father's/husband's name must be spelt exactly as per certificates/mark sheets; any discrepancy may lead to disqualification. Applications with incorrect, incomplete details, or without the required certificate copies are liable to be rejected. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any stage of the process without assigning a reason. Shortlisted applicants will be individually communicated by post or email with interview details. No correspondence will be entertained regarding eligibility, interview, or selection matters - the Bank's decision is final.

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility (educational qualification, cadre, and minimum experience) is assessed as on 31.07.2026, the reference date given in the notification for age calculation. Requirements vary by post as summarized below. Head Analytics & AI (DVP): Lead the bank's data-driven transformation; AI/ML and generative AI frameworks; Vector Databases & RAG Systems; SAS Viya, IBM CP4D, R, Python; model evaluation and explainability. IT Infrastructure – Lead Systems/Servers (AVP): Server maintenance, storage, database management, Active Directory; VMware/OpenShift/Kubernetes; RHCSA/MCP/VCTA/Nutanix certifications preferred. Data Scientist/Statistician (AVP): Enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions, predictive modelling, AI/ML platforms and MLOps, stakeholder management. IT Infrastructure – Data Center Manager: 24/7/365 data center availability, security protocols, regulatory compliance; CDCP/RHCSA/VCTA/Nutanix certifications preferred. Senior Software Engineer (Data Science, Statistics & ML): Python, SQL, R, Spark/PySpark, cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), Power BI/Tableau; credit risk, fraud and customer analytics. Senior Software Engineers – Programmers/Developers: Java, .NET, Python; REST APIs; Git-based SDLC; CI/CD and DevOps practices. Senior Software Engineer – Testing & QA: Functional, regression, SIT, UAT, automation testing; Jira, ALM/Zephyr/TestRail, Postman/REST Assured. Software Engineer – Data Analyst with AI/ML Modelling: EDA, predictive analytics, classification/regression models, NLP (desirable), model deployment and monitoring. IT Infrastructure – Server Administrators: Windows Server/Linux (RHEL) administration, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), Active Directory, security hardening. IT Infrastructure – Network & Security Administrators: LAN/WAN/wireless administration, firewalls, DR/business continuity planning; CISSP/CISM/CEH preferred. IT Infrastructure – Cloud Administrators: AWS/Azure/GCP infrastructure management, IAM, CI/CD, cost optimization; AWS SysOps/Azure Administrator certifications preferred. Software Engineer – Programmers/Developers: Java (Spring Boot)/C#.NET, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, SQL; React/Angular, Docker, Kubernetes desirable. Software Engineer – Oracle Fusion: Oracle Fusion, VMS/CX modules, OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, OTBI/BI Publisher. Oracle HCM (Payroll & Integrations / Talent, Workflow & Experience): Oracle Fusion HCM, Talent Management, Oracle Journeys, Workflow, HDL, HCM Extracts. Candidates preparing for other private sector bank recruitments can check the latest Bank Recruitment 2026 notifications for more openings.

faq.question: Q1. What is TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. inviting online applications for 14 specialized Specialist Officer (IT) roles covering Data Science, AI/ML, IT Infrastructure, Software Engineering, and Oracle Fusion/HCM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 6 September 2026. Applications opened on 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for TMB Specialist Officer (IT)?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from B.E/B.Tech/MCA for junior roles to M.E/B.Tech/MCA with 20 years of experience for the Head Analytics & AI (DVP) post. A PhD is desirable for the Data Scientist/Statistician role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) posts?
faq.answer: Age limit ranges from 28 years (Assistant Manager cadre roles) to 45 years (DVP and AVP cadre roles), as on 31.07.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee. The notification states "Application Fee: Nil" for all posts.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only online through https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ by registering, filling in application details, uploading photo, signature, and required documents, and submitting before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TMB Specialist Officer (IT)?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting of applications followed by a Personal Interview conducted through Direct mode or Video Conferencing.

faq.question: Q8. Where will TMB Specialist Officer (IT) selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: As per the General Conditions in the notification, the posting will be at Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
